facts.anchor: Her body throbbed in time with the drips.
Flies buzzed in abstract patterns through the cobwebs in her mind
Her friend, his skin a sickly dusty color and dark curls floating around him in a halo, bobbed in the stone bath full of even more thick crimson.
She’ll never be gone because love and memories never die.
She needed to get herself and Vix home.
Hey, there. You look like you’ve got one serious story to tell, witch.
One witch prisoner and her corpse companion.
